description: The October 17, 2026 snapshot of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash supports text and image input, tool calling, and optional reasoning with low, high, and max effort. It has a shared 1,048,576-token context window and supports up to 393,216 output tokens within the remaining context. Released under the MIT license.
name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 Thinking
